__inputs.name: DS_TRACE_PILOT
__inputs.label: InfluxDB trace-pilot (Flux)
__inputs.description: 버킷 trace-pilot을 읽는 Flux 데이터 소스. 읽기 토큰은 Grafana 데이터 소스에만 넣는다

title: TRACE 파일럿 추이
description: FR-PIL-02: 파일럿 기기(별칭)별 배터리·벤치마크 추이. 측정값은 diagnostics-server가 trace-pilot에 쓴다(DI2)

list.name: alias
list.label: 파일럿 기기
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "trace-pilot", tag: "alias", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "trace_battery" or r._measurement == "trace_benchmark", start: -365d)

list.name: metric
list.label: 벤치마크 지표
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "trace-pilot", tag: "metric", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "trace_benchmark", start: -365d)

panels.title: 배터리 건강도 (%) = 완충 용량 ÷ 설계 용량

targets.query:
from(bucket: "trace-pilot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trace_battery" and r._field == "healthPercent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.alias, set: ${alias:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["alias"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "alias"])

from(bucket: "trace-pilot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trace_battery" and r._field == "cycleCount")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.alias, set: ${alias:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["alias"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "alias"])

from(bucket: "trace-pilot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trace_benchmark" and r._field == "median" and r.metric == "${metric}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.alias, set: ${alias:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["alias", "unit"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "alias", "unit"])
